parent.behavior_scope: one local spare, explicit LRU removal and fit, then local direct repair

source.source_boundary: An SRU belongs to an LRU in ItemStructure. A child-caused LRU failure uses ItemRepair/ItemReplacement SURP to exchange the SRU; a removed faulty SRU can use direct repair. ItemReplacement overrides general SURP timing. The parent's intrinsic failure rate equals its child's rate, leaving no direct LRU failure residual.

delta.mechanism: Add one SRU beneath the accepted LRU with matching 300000-hour FRT, local one-unit SRU stock, 1.5-hour general LRU SURP and overriding 0.75-hour item-specific LRU/SRU replacement, plus one-hour SRU direct repair. Preserve the E01 aircraft, missions, LRU stock, and system removal/fit task.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Import/export preserves every author-populated table and row including the new LRU/SRU relation and ItemReplacement; all native steps return zero, conversion errors are zero, and valid nonempty events and report are emitted.

At least one native critical aircraft failure identifies the installed LRU. When the removed LRU arrives for local repair, its event must identify the nested failed SRU; the aircraft receives a replacement LRU and returns ready after the inherited 10-minute REMOVE plus 20-minute REPLACE sequence.

The removed LRU enters a local SURP task, demands one SRU, receives a local stock issue, and completes in the item-specific 0.75 hours rather than the 1.5-hour general LRU SURP. The removed SRU then enters a one-hour local DIRP task and returns to SRU stock; the repaired LRU returns to LRU stock.

Reconcile the native event identities and times, LRU and SRU demand and stock ledgers, mission outcomes, system intervals, and terminal aircraft and inventory state without silently accepting backorders or forwarding.
Bind invocation and closure to the frozen input, parent, builder, contract, checker, executable, and raw-file hashes; independently replay acceptance read-only.
limits: This first G01 variant accepts only one LRU/SRU chain. ASSY, quantities, other item types, residual direct LRU failures, parent rate errors, and additional repair levels remain planned.
